description: DiligenceOps: submit data export or portability claims about formats, scope and timing and the terms or help pages offered for them. The signed report marks each claim supported, contradicted or never mentioned, matching formats such as CSV, JSON and XLSX as named items and durations in any unit, with quotes. POST /api/export-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-vendor-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

claims.description: Data export or portability claims about formats, scope and timing, for example "Export all your data as CSV or JSON at any time, within 24 hours of a request". As one text, which is split into parts at sentences, semicolons, commas and joining words, or as a list of up to 50 parts.

evidence.description: The terms, help pages, data processing agreement or other evidence. As text, or up to 200 excerpts as {source, text}. Up to 256 KB in all.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

name: wever_export-evidence-check
title: Export evidence check
